verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents threshold-based alerts on Errors, Cost, and Feedback Score (along with Run Count and Latency). Errors alerts support stackable filters, and Feedback Score alerts can cover scores from online evaluators. Alerts route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any webhook endpoint. Missing for 10: email as a documented notification channel, explicit confirmation that online-eval scores feed Feedback Score alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
